summary: NECOIN EIENDOM AS (org. no. 981 943 252) is a private limited company (AS) based in Randaberg, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2000-05-05. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 2.9 m and net income was NOK 1.2 m. Board chair: Helge Olsen; auditor: REVISJON VEST AS.
